newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to give television interview Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to give television interview Wednesday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will give a television interview to government-controlled Russia Television on Wednesday, Interfax news agency quoted the Kremlin as saying.
Presidential press secretary Sergei Yastrzhembsky gave no details of the rare interview, but sources at Russia Television said it would be shown at around 8 p.m. (1600 GMT).
News of Yeltsin's interview followed an agreement reached with NATO on Wednesday to forge a new relationship between Moscow and its former Cold War foe.
Yeltsin has been widely expected to go on television to discuss a planned union treaty with western neighbour Belarus which is expected to be signed on May 23.
Russia Television broadcast an interview with Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko on Saturday.
